architecture: Two ReLU hidden layers of width 64. For the four-member model, linear layers share the main weight matrix but have member-specific multiplicative input/output vectors and biases; output heads are independent. This is an inspired BatchEnsemble implementation, not a claimed exact TabM replication.
checkpoint: Best preceding-noon validation balanced accuracy, averaged equally across training assets; tie by natural log loss. Assessment cannot choose epoch.
confirmation: The original substantial-gain gate remains unfulfilled. This screen cannot establish independent confirmation.
constant_features: Drop columns that are constant in training only, before fitting the quantile transform.
evidence_status: Development only; no reserved evaluation observations opened.
features: Frozen event_cross features, full-day eligible data, four training dates per fold.
hypothesis: Shared cross-asset training, robust quantile normalization and parameter-sharing neural ensembles can reduce variance and improve transfer between activity regimes.
initialization: Independent output heads; first input adapters are standard normal, all later multiplicative adapters start at one. The single-member control is an ordinary two-hidden-layer MLP.
loss: Average the cross-entropy losses of all ensemble members; weight by inverse class frequency within each training asset and equalize asset mass. Average member probabilities only for prediction.
normalization: Training-only QuantileTransformer with 1024 quantiles, normal output, at most 100000 training observations, fixed seed; explicit asset indicator appended after normalization.
posterior: Convert balanced class posteriors to natural posteriors using the corresponding asset training priors.
primary_metric: Unchanged three-class balanced accuracy; ordinary accuracy and natural log loss secondary.
splits: Same May 21/22/23 development assessments, with preceding four training dates and one validation date.
